outlines.outline: A wants a valid apology and corrected witness account; B wants privacy. Copy a hand gesture as ritual and preserve confident insistence after correction.
Siblings revise an apology email; A copies a red error mark as formatting expertise and covers it by prescribing explicit responsibility. B wants to send an adequate apology.
Festival colleagues check sums; A copies a checking tick as approval and wants endorsement on record. B supports the idea but fears repeating a cost mistake.
Neighbours mark a fence; A copies a rotten-post mark as assent then wants signed consent before repairs. B allows it now but not perpetually.
Housemates dispute bin duty. A copies a holiday marking as rotation, then covers through a genuinely relevant swap rule. B wants last week counted.
Outgoing and incoming club officers exchange keys. A copies a spare return as handover and uses the actual minutes to shift cleaning. B hopes the caretaker still does it.
Party guests fill a timeline; A miscopies stain circles as balanced coverage. B suspects a cake inquiry. A must keep other gaps genuinely in play instead of announcing the priority.
Shared-car users fill a log. A copies taps as procedure and hides the likely dent priority by doing the work needed for other fields. B would rather give the easy answer.
Festival helpers hold a lantern. A copies a nod to another person as appointment consent and preserves that mistake by assigning a witnessed role. B wants the brief favor finished.
Fundraisers arrange an appeal. A copies clapping as a welcome and makes B patron despite correction. B will attend but not speak, so applause becomes a binding ceremony.
